title: Step 1 - Getting Started with Naive Bayes Algorithm in R for Classification

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: Today we are going to implement the Naive Bayes algorithm on R.
cues.zh: 今天要在 R 實作樸素貝氏演算法。

cues.en: So let's start right now.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: Let's first set to Folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 先把資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: So I'm going to part three classifications, and that's the folder.
cues.zh: 進入 Part 3 Classification，就是這個資料夾。

cues.en: So make sure you have this social network ads here as we File.
cues.zh: 確認有 Social_Network_Ads.csv 檔案。

cues.en: And if that's the case, click on this More button here, to set this folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 如果有，點這裡的 More，將此資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: And now let's start implementing Naive Bayes on R.
cues.zh: 現在開始在 R 實作樸素貝氏。

cues.en: So we're gonna take our classification templates, we're gonna take everything from here, to here,
cues.zh: 取分類範本，把這裡到這裡全部選取，

cues.en: and then paste right here.
cues.zh: 再貼到這裡。

cues.en: And now we just need to change a few things.
cues.zh: 現在只需改幾個地方。

cues.en: So first let's change the titles, our usuals, so that we don't forget.
cues.zh: 先和往常一樣修改標題，免得忘記。

cues.en: So here we are with the Naive Bayes classifier.
cues.zh: 這裡是 Naive Bayes classifier。

cues.en: Same for the training set.
cues.zh: 訓練集也一樣。

cues.en: So that is plotting the title in our graphs, and now we all need to do is to create our Naive Bayes classifier.
cues.zh: 這是繪製圖表中的標題，現在只需要建立樸素貝氏分類器。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 來做。

cues.en: Going to remove this, and now, what are we gonna do?
cues.zh: 移除這段，現在該做什麼？

cues.en: Well it's actually funny because we're gonna use a library, that we all ready used before, but for a different classifier, it's the e1071 library.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，要用之前用過的函式庫，只是當時用於不同的分類器，也就是 e1071。

cues.en: So there is no surprise why this library is very popular, one of the most popular ones, because it contains a lot of tools.
cues.zh: 所以這個函式庫非常熱門、是最熱門之一，並不意外，因為它包含很多工具。

cues.en: Tools for SVM and tools for Naive Bayes.
cues.zh: 有 SVM 工具與樸素貝氏工具。

cues.en: So here again we'll use this library.
cues.zh: 這裡再次使用它。

cues.en: So for those of you who didn't follow the SVM tutorials on R, and those of you who are starting R for the first time, maybe you don't have the e1071 packages,
cues.zh: 如果沒跟著做 R 的 SVM 教學，或第一次使用 R，套件清單中可能沒有 e1071

cues.en: in your packages list.
cues.zh: 套件。

cues.en: So if that's the case, you just need to type the command here install.packages, and then in quote here in the parenthesis,
cues.zh: 如果是這樣，只需輸入 install.packages 命令，再在小括號中的引號裡，

cues.en: you just add the name of the library, which is e1071.
cues.zh: 加上函式庫名稱 e1071。

cues.en: And then you need to select this and execute, to install the packages.
cues.zh: 選取並執行，就能安裝套件。

cues.en: I won't do it here because I all ready have mine installed.
cues.zh: 我這裡不執行，因為已經裝好了。

cues.en: But I promise you that it will work properly.
cues.zh: 但保證它能正常運作。

cues.en: So, I'm just going to put that in comment, here we go.
cues.zh: 所以把它設為註解，好了。

cues.en: And now let's also import the library that is to selected in the packages list, because here it's selected, but it might not always be the case.
cues.zh: 現在也要匯入函式庫，也就是在套件清單中選取它。這裡已選取，但未必一直如此。

cues.en: And if you want to ultimate your machine learning script, it's better to always have this script line here, that selects automatically your packages.
cues.zh: 如果要讓機器學習指令碼自動執行，最好始終保留這一行，自動載入套件。

cues.en: So library e1071, and now we are ready to start creating our Naive Bayes classifier. Okay so let's do this.
cues.zh: library(e1071)，現在就能開始建立樸素貝氏分類器。來做。

cues.en: As usual we will create a variable classifier,
cues.zh: 一樣先建立 classifier 變數，

cues.en: and then we will use the Naive Bayes function off the e1071 library.
cues.zh: 再使用 e1071 函式庫的 naiveBayes 函式。

cues.en: The e1071 library contains a lot of functions, and one of them is to create a Naive Bayes classifier.
cues.zh: e1071 包含很多函式，其中一個用來建立樸素貝氏分類器。

cues.en: Okay? So, careful with the capitals, so it's not capital N, but capital B. All right?
cues.zh: 注意大小寫，n 不是大寫，但 B 是大寫，好嗎？

cues.en: But then you know R is helping you with the terms, so you would have this naive vice popping up here, so you just have to press Enter.
cues.zh: 不過 R 會協助補全，所以會跳出 naiveBayes，直接按 Enter 就好。

cues.en: And now let's input the parameters.
cues.zh: 現在輸入參數。

cues.en: So the parameters, what are they? Let's look at them.
cues.zh: 參數是什麼？看看。

cues.en: We press F1 here to have a look, and here they are.
cues.zh: 在這裡按 F1，參數出來了。

cues.en: So, we will actually need to input only the two first Arguments.
cues.zh: 其實只需要輸入前兩個引數。

cues.en: We won't need to input the formula like for the other one.
cues.zh: 不像其他模型，不需要輸入公式。

cues.en: It will work perfectly well with only the first two ones.
cues.zh: 只用前兩個就能正常運作。

cues.en: So you'll see, let's input X here, which is by the way, the training set.
cues.zh: 你會看到，這裡輸入 x，也就是訓練集。

cues.en: So the training set, but we need to remove the last column of our training set.
cues.zh: 但要移除訓練集最後一欄。

cues.en: Because x is actually the matrix features you see.
cues.zh: 因為 x 其實是特徵矩陣。

cues.en: It's written here, a numeric matrix, or data frame.
cues.zh: 這裡寫數值矩陣，或資料框。

cues.en: By that it mean the matrix it features that is the matrix of the independent variable.
cues.zh: 意思是特徵矩陣，也就是自變數矩陣。

cues.en: So here since the training set contains both the independent variables and the dependent variable, we need to exclude the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 因為訓練集同時包含自變數與應變數，所以要排除應變數。

cues.en: So to do this, we're gonna add a bracket here, and remove the last column by imputing here a minus, and then the index of the last column, which is,
cues.zh: 做法是在這裡加中括號，輸入負號，再加最後一欄的索引，移除最後一欄。

cues.en: well we can see here it's -3, so it's -3.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到是第三欄，所以寫 -3。

cues.en: All right so perfect then comma, and then next Argument.
cues.zh: 好，很好，再加逗號，接著下一個引數。

cues.en: So do you guess what the next Argument is?
cues.zh: 猜得到下一個引數是什麼嗎？

cues.en: Well of course to train a classifier, we need the independent variables and the response.
cues.zh: 當然，訓練分類器需要自變數與回應。

cues.en: And the response is the dependent variable, so of course y is going to be the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 回應就是應變數，所以 y 當然是應變數。

cues.en: So, y equals, and to take it, we're going to take it this way, we're gonna input training set$Purchased.
cues.zh: 寫 y 等於，接著這樣取得它，輸入 training_set$Purchased。

cues.en: So I'm choosing to write it this way because we can clearly see that we are taking the dependent variable purchased.
cues.zh: 我選這種寫法，是因為能清楚看到取的是應變數 Purchased。
